name: Sandloop
storyline:
In the lands of Iman, a festival is held every year. During the celebrations, a special ceremony takes place where the young are given important clothes and the Mindil —magical cloths that hide long-forgotten powers.

This year, it is Hura’s turn, but her experience will be very different from the ones before. Strangers attack the village, trying to steal an ancient power. In the middle of the chaos, Hura escapes and finds a loom that gives her magical powers through her new clothes.

With the blessing of the tribe’s elder, she sets out on a journey to learn new abilities, stop the invaders, and uncover a mystery that weaves itself with every jump.
summary: Help Hura save her village from invaders by exploring the intricate lands of Iman and gaining ancient skills that will enhance her mobility!
